Stalk $GDX via $NUGT 2x Long (Another Bullish Flag)
$GDX morphed into another shorter term bullish flag after an initial 40% rally from the 5-months flag breakout pattern. The current flag is only 5 weeks old after retracing -10% from the peak, so any breakout from this structure may have a much shorter lifespan.

Focus $MSFT via $MSFU 2x Long (Pre-Market Gapper Out Of Weekly Bullish Pennant)
Pre-market now is breaking out of the weekly bullish pennant. Don't need RVOL but will hold off the first 30mins and only looking for <70% LoD at ORH for execution.

Stalk $U (Re-base again, first higher low)
$U was in stalk and focus during the first 2 weeks of Sept. Friday (11/9) attempt breakout on RVOL with expanded price action. price squat and flatten with lower high and lower low for following 5 sessions. Yesterday was only the first higher low, while price remains right beneath the pivotal $43.70. Need 2 more tighten price action with higher low rebuild from here.

re-set alert at re-ORH at $508.50
i will only set this buy stop order 30mins after market settles even without RVOL for high liquid names like $MSFT

Focus $XBI via $LABU 3x Long (DTL Breakout, Bullish Resumption)
Looking at this idea today at $LABU 6.3% ADR. $XBI bottomed on Sept 16 (Last Wed) after starting the month with series of lower high candles to form a structured downtrend line. Sept 17th thrusted out of DTL and has sideway since with 3 days of higher low. Wait for 30mins settlement before ORH <70% entry.
